case: Boundary G1 (re-cut for Epic 05 Story 6) — trajectory: turn-end trigger, whole-turn eviction, peek-ahead stop, mid-turn batches never move, the close heals

batches.label: B1 under max: turn t1 closes at zone 40 <= 100, boundary holds at origin
B2 still under max: t2 closes at zone 80 <= 100, boundary holds

B3 crosses max: t3 closes at zone 120 > 100; whole-turn walk excluding the newest closed turn: evict t1 (remaining 80 >= target 60), peek t2 would leave 40 < 60 -> stop; position = t1's last result (order 5)
B4 under max after the advance: t4 closes at zone 90 <= 100, no movement (never backward, no churn)
B5 mid-turn: t5 stays open with zone 170 > 100; no turn_end commits, so no check runs and the boundary holds (AC-5.1)

B6 the close heals: the prompt closes t5 (close_then_open) and the turn_end commits; zone 170 > 100; walk evicts t2 (130 >= 60), t3 (90 >= 60), t4 (80 >= 60) and stops at the newest closed turn t5 (80, never a candidate); position = t4's result (order 21)
